Lemma
[Time covariant derivative of tensor components] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0455 ↗ def:chow-ii-frame-time-vector ↗ lem:chow-ii-vertical-tensor-action 1. appf:F.33\group Ricci-Flow Frame Bundle

For a time-dependent $(p,q)$-tensor, \[ egin{aligned} abla _t U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p} ={}& \partial _tU^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p} +\sum _{j=1}^pR_{b_jc}g^{cd}U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots d\cdots b_p}\ & -\sum _{i=1}^qg^{a_ic}R_c{}^dU^{a_1\cdots d\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}. \end{aligned} \] In particular, $ abla _tg_{ab}=0$.
